Users
  Id
  Email unique
  Name
  CreatedAt datetime
Roles
  Id
  Name
UserRoles
  UserId -> Users
  RoleId -> Roles
  pk (UserId, RoleId)
Sessions
  Id
  UserId -> Users
  Token
  ExpiresAt datetime
Addresses
  Id
  UserId -> Users
  CountryId -> Countries
  Street
  City
Countries
  Id
  Name
  Code vc(2)
Categories
  Id
  Name
  ParentId null -> Categories
Products
  Id
  Name
  CategoryId -> Categories
  SupplierId -> Suppliers
  Price decimal(8,2)
Suppliers
  Id
  Name
  CountryId -> Countries
ProductImages
  Id
  ProductId -> Products
  Url
Reviews
  Id
  ProductId -> Products
  UserId -> Users
  Rating int
  Body text
Warehouses
  Id
  Name
  AddressId -> Addresses
Inventory
  ProductId -> Products
  WarehouseId -> Warehouses
  Quantity int
  pk (ProductId, WarehouseId)
Carts
  Id
  UserId -> Users
CartItems
  CartId -> Carts
  ProductId -> Products
  Quantity int
  pk (CartId, ProductId)
Orders
  Id
  UserId -> Users
  ShippingAddressId -> Addresses
  StatusId -> OrderStatus
  CouponId null -> Coupons
  CreatedAt datetime
OrderStatus
  Id
  Name
OrderItems
  Id
  OrderId -> Orders
  ProductId -> Products
  Quantity int
  UnitPrice decimal(8,2)
Coupons
  Id
  Code unique
  Percent int
Payments
  Id
  OrderId -> Orders
  MethodId -> PaymentMethods
  Amount decimal(8,2)
PaymentMethods
  Id
  Name
Shipments
  Id
  OrderId -> Orders
  WarehouseId -> Warehouses
  CarrierId -> Carriers
  ShippedAt datetime null
Carriers
  Id
  Name
AuditLog
  Id
  UserId null -> Users
  Action
  At datetime
